_comment: Intentional exceptions to tools/check_public_hygiene.py. Every entry needs a reason. Secrets (SECRET-*, FORBIDDEN-FILE) can never be listed here. Keep this list short; see docs/PUBLIC_HYGIENE.md.

allow.reason: Published maintainer / security contact (SECURITY.md, CITATION.cff, README, pyproject metadata); deliberately public.
Public web sites of the CAMCEAD project and CASU (download and calibration-query pages, project links); not internal hosts.
Public CASU helpdesk address quoted as the value of the SOFTAUTH FITS keyword in the data model description.
Paths inside the container image (unprivileged build user and apt cache cleanup), not a host machine.
Dockerfile is not a demo block (container-internal paths only).
